entries.text: Wuff!
entries.label: legend_0120_mastiff_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]All right! You ready for a battle,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_01

entries.text: You come up to me just to tell me no? C’mon,\nlittle bud—don’t mess with me like that![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_02

entries.text: Excellent! You’re ready too, right, Mabosstiff?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_03

entries.text: Bu-wuff! Wuff!
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_04

entries.text: Yep, Mabosstiff says he’s ready![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_05

entries.text: You’re battling with Mabosstiff?!
entries.label: legend_0120_select_01

entries.text: Wait, are you sure about this?!
entries.label: legend_0120_select_02

entries.text: OK, yeah, I can see why you’d be worried...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_06

entries.text: But my buddy here’s bursting with energy! You’d\nnever know he was so weak just a little while ago![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_07

entries.text: Won’t leave me alone—always whining at me,\nwanting to battle you and your Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_08

entries.text:
It’s been so long I nearly forgot, but he always
did love to battle.\c
Even if we always lost to that student council
girl—the battle fanatic one.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_09

entries.text: Anyway, my point is there’s no need to worry![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_10

entries.text: We’re a brand-new Arven and Mabosstiff! And\nwe’re feeling audacious—or maybe herbaceous?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_11

entries.text: Let me give you a taste of what we can do![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_12

entries.text: Dang... This is the strength of someone who\ncould take down those Titan Pokémon, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_13

entries.text: Yeah, much as I hate to admit it...I do think we’re\ngonna need some more support.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_14

entries.text: The Pokémon in Area Zero are super strong, and\nthere are all sorts of weird machines there, too.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_15

entries.text: I’d say we need at least two more people...\nSomebody with some [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Champion Rank–level skills[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\r\nand somebody who can [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]deal with crazy tech[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_16

entries.text: That sounds like Nemona!
entries.label: legend_0120_select_03

entries.text: That sounds like Penny!
entries.label: legend_0120_select_04

entries.text: Maybe...Nemona?
entries.label: legend_0120_select_05

entries.text: Maybe...Penny?
entries.label: legend_0120_select_06

entries.text: The student council president?\c\nYou’re probably right. That girl can take on any\nPokémon that comes at her. She’s a beast![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_16a

entries.text:
Penny? That crazy-smart hacker girl who was
the big boss behind Team Star?\c
I mean, yeah, she’d be perfect for the job...
But when did you go making friends with some
shady character like her?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_16b

entries.text:
The student council girl?\c
Yeah, she’d be perfect for the job, but I doubt
she’d give us the time of day unless one of us
was on her level. As in Champion Rank level.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_16c

entries.text:
Huh? Never knew we had someone all tech savvy
like that at school.\c
But I doubt someone with those skills would
bother helping us out unless she owed us...
or at least liked us.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_16d

entries.text: But, well, we’ve gotta do what we’ve gotta do!\c\nWhoever you think could be a help, just try\ngetting in good with ’em![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_17a

entries.text: We’ll see if we can’t get a team together. Get in\ntouch if you make progress—I’ll do the same![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_18a

entries.text: Huh! Well, seems like you’ve been busy making\nsome pretty useful friends![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_17b

entries.text:
I’ll reach out to them and organize things. You
just make sure you’re there.\c
The meeting place will be the Zero Gate. It’s this
facility out on the edge of the Great Crater.\c
I’ll send you the info on how to find it, so don’t
keep us waiting forever![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0120_friend_18b
